arithmetic.work: 10,000,000 checked additions, comparisons, increments, assignments, and final validation

calls.work: 10,000,000 private function calls inside a checked accumulation loop

failure.purpose: Typed success and try propagation overhead
failure.work: 10,000,000 successful failable calls and postfix try operations

generic.work: 10,000,000 specialized generic identity calls inside a checked loop

known.work: A compile-time constant and one runtime result validation

allocation.work: One exact-size 10,000-element construction followed by one exact-size generic map

branch.purpose: Persistent append from an older sequence version
branch.work: Build 10,000 values, retain the 5,000-value version, then perform 1,000 independent appends from it

growth.work: 10,000 newest-version appends, one retained 5,000-value version, and one verified branch from that version

iteration.work: Construct and iterate 1,000,000 unsigned values with checksum validation

lookup.work: 1,000,000 checked dynamic lookups over a 10,000-element exact-size sequence

runtime.purpose: Standard runtime and one hosted query baseline
runtime.work: Runtime initialization, one core-count query, validation, and shutdown

returned.purpose: Owned sequence return and caller release cost
returned.work: 128 function returns of independently owned 10,000-element unsigned sequences, full checksums, and releases
